goal: Align leader resolve with ULS: resume applies only to WorkItem escalated without a batch blocker while needs_human batches and lane_executor_no_progress children admit only ask_owner (the recorded amendment of loop-leader D4 and S4-AC1); a Lane dialog is asked once by planEscalation and a leader ask_owner on it annotates in place; lane_session_unavailable never counts as a refusal or replan round nor changes the briefing fingerprint and shows as environment_blocked in status; batch lookup uses findActiveLaneBatchForTask and briefing batches carry v3 session facts, per D5 of docs/specs/loop-leader-uls-alignment.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-A2, BR-REQ-A1; meet D5.1 and D5.4 in docs/specs/loop-leader-uls-alignment.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-leader-replan.test.ts, tests/loop-leader-briefing.test.ts. Done looks like: resume on an escalated item with no batch blocker is accepted; briefing batches carry each child's session generation, no_progress and attention. Negative: resume on a needs_human batch or a lane_executor_no_progress child is rejected and only ask_owner is accepted; two active batch records for one task make the batch lookup refuse instead of taking the first file.

Source BR-DEC-A3, BR-SCN-A2; meet D5.2 in docs/specs/loop-leader-uls-alignment.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-leader-replan.test.ts, tests/loop-sched-interaction-github.test.ts. Done looks like: a child blocked on a startup dialog yields exactly one lane_entry_blocked comment on the Issue and appears in the briefing as a pending interaction. Negative: a leader ask_owner on the same subject annotates that request in place and posts no second comment.

Source BR-DEC-A6, BR-SCN-A4; meet D5.3 in docs/specs/loop-leader-uls-alignment.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-leader-briefing.test.ts, tests/loop-leader-replan.test.ts. Done looks like: five ticks refused lane_session_unavailable leave refused_transitions, replan_rounds, the briefing fingerprint and the leader wake count unchanged, and imm-loop status --json shows environment_blocked lane_session_unavailable on the item. Negative: a different refusal reason still counts toward the three-refusal trigger.

scope_size_reason: The resume rule, the single-question rule and the refusal exclusion all change what the leader may do with a blocked batch and share the briefing and replan code; together they are one resolve contract.
